name: kv_cache_shared
doc: One engine per actor in front of a store with no index (LMCache fs://): stat lookups, chunks written to a temporary name and renamed.

meta_bytes.doc: the header in front of a chunk (traced: seven 32-bit integers)

buf.doc: Python BufferedReader size = st_blksize; the first read of a chunk file is this long

sys_tokens_min.doc: bounds of the system prompt length; equal bounds give every prompt that length

sys_local.doc: [config] the engine holds the system prompts in GPU memory and never reads their chunks (traced); false: a system prompt is a prefix like the conversation's own, and its chunks are read when the engine holds none of the conversation (a new one, or one whose `keep` draw is under a chunk: measured in the AgentX replay, where the engine held the system prompt and some of the conversation or neither, §3.63)

sys_per_slot.doc: [config: load] a slot's conversations all start with the system prompt of its own index (sessions of an agent, each with its own, §3.63); false picks one per conversation by `sys_pop`

reuse.doc: none for a new conversation (measured: 0.148 of ShareGPT's requests are first turns), or requests ago: the conversations a slot has open and serves in turn [config: load]. One distance: with several, two requests can continue the same one

keep.doc: [config: GPU KV memory against the open conversations] the tokens of a returning conversation the engine still holds, counted from its start: all of it when the draw exceeds its length, else the chunks past them are loaded. Drawn once per round of the open conversations (the GPU's memory is one state for all of them), so a round's loads come together

context.doc: [config: model] a conversation whose next prompt and reply would not fit starts anew

turns.doc: [config: load] the requests a conversation has, drawn when it starts; 0 for no limit, the conversation then ends by `reuse`'s none arm or the context. A session of many turns and a side call of one are the same slot's conversations (measured in the AgentX corpus, §3.59)

trim.doc: [config: load] tokens the client drops from the end of its conversation before a request (an agent editing its context; measured in the AgentX corpus, §3.59); the chunks past the kept prefix are stored again under their names, where the real store writes new files

turn_in.doc: the tokens a request adds to its conversation's prompt (measured: ShareGPT user turns, twenty equal shares, each its mean)

turn_out.doc: generated tokens (measured: ShareGPT replies, the same way)

prefill_step.doc: [config: engine] tokens per prefill step (vLLM's max_num_batched_tokens: 8192 for an API server on a large GPU, 2048 otherwise); the chunks a step completes are stored after it, so a long prompt's writes come in bursts of prefill_step / chunk_tokens

think.doc: [config: load] the client's delay before a request (its user's or its agent's think time); zero sends a slot's requests back to back
